request.description: Texts the co-applicant a one-time consent code (`consent.otp` template, DLT key `SMS_DLT_TEMPLATE_CONSENT_OTP`) and returns the consent template to show them. Resend cooldown and limits match sign-in OTPs. Borrower context for the applicant's own records; partner context for applications the firm filed (agents: the ones they filed). Others get 404.

response.name: 200 OK
